title: The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
main_claim: For every q in (0,1) and every eta in (0,1), there is a compact set E in [0,1] with m(E) > 1-eta that contains no affine copy x + s{q^n : n>=1} with s != 0. In other words, G_q is not measure universal.
coverage:
I read the whole LaTeX source (5 sections) line by line and checked every step.
(1) Reduction from the periodic proposition to the main theorem: the dyadic normalization s = 2^k t and the reflection are correct. The measure budget 12·sum p_k·max(1,2^k) = 7·eta/16 was confirmed with sympy.
(2) Nested dyadic grids N_b, sized about c·q^{-b} with c = 4/(1-q): the nesting and the bound cq^{-b} <= N_b < 2cq^{-b} hold.
(3) Window lengths: the recursion r_h = max(r_0, g + sigma_{h-1}) gives the span bound b*_e - a_e + 1 <= 2r_h.
(4) Stability lemma: the density bound 2N_{b'}q^{a_e} <= 4cq^{g+1} is right, using a_e = b' + g + 1. Keys of earlier edges are preserved, and the half-open cell conventions are handled correctly.
(5) Separation: the cell width satisfies 1/N_b <= (1-q)q^b/4 < (1-q)q^b, which is at most the smallest gap between test points. All points lie within an arc of length 1/4.
(6) Routing preservation: every selector edge read at an ancestor of U, and every edge (U,j) with j < i, comes before e_i in preorder, so the stability lemma applies to it.
(7) Independent tests: given the conditioning atom, the selector bits A_{i,n} are i.i.d. fair bits because their keys differ from the center's exposed key. The terminal addresses are distinct (different subtrees, or the same leaf with a finer grid). This gives exactly (1-p/2)^{(M-1)r}.
(8) Scale count: each test Q_i is determined by the single key J_{b*}(z). The number of lattice crossings is at most 1 + 2cq^{-2r}. Endpoints plus midpoints give at most D. Every t in [1,2] is represented, including boundary values. The representative set depends only on x and U, so it is fixed by the conditioning.
(9) Parameter choices: M is chosen so that alpha > 2·log(1/q), then d, then K, then g, then r_*. The order is consistent and not circular.
(10) Final step: E rho(R) <= 3p and rho(H) <= 6p. R is closed because it is the projection of a compact set. Adding an open neighbourhood V of R covers every remaining center because tq^n -> 0.
I found no gap. The key idea is that the number of scales to check depends only on the window length r_h, not on the finest grid in the whole tree, and the argument for this holds.
sibling_notes: Family 084 was empty on the board when I checked. The paper is self-contained and does not depend on companion papers.
